description: Creates a 2-channel equivalent of a mono file: both output channels verified BIT-EQUAL to the source (dual-mono, no level change, no artifacts - unlike chans 3's buggy mono path). Stereo input refused ('ERROR: CANNOT ACHIEVE TASK: / ERROR: This file is already stereo!!'). Parameterless; duration static, sample-exact; deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart).
musical_use: The format adapter for stereo-only ops and mixed-format sessions: phase phase 2 (stereo enhance), submix work at fixed channel counts, or any chain where a mono render must sit alongside stereo files without channel-count refusals ('Incompatible channel-count in input file ...' from sfedit join, modify sausage and friends). Dual-mono is dead-center imaging - follow with phase phase 2, per-channel processing (zero one side via chans 3, or process L/R renders differently and interleave), or modify pan-family ops to earn actual width. Round-trip with chans 4 is lossless in this direction (mono -> dual-mono -> (L+R)/2 = the original).

examples.description: Promote a mono render to stereo for a stereo-only chain.
examples.expected_use: Dual-mono output, both channels bit-equal to the input; duration unchanged.

known_issues: Mono-only: stereo input refused verbatim ('This file is already stereo!!').
Output is DUAL-MONO (channels bit-identical, verified) - no widening; it earns you the channel count, not an image.
Bit-clean, unlike chans 3's mono-to-one-side path (which drops one sample per 16384 frames); prefer this + chans 3-on-stereo when a one-sided file must be exact.
